g.text: Operations are numbered. The Knowledge Graph (center) is read at steps 2 and 5, written at step 6.
Four-Layer Ontology · Functional · Design · Architecture · Code
read on the way in (step 2) · audited at the gate (step 5) · written on the way out (step 6)
STEP 6 · KG SYNC SUB-FLOW (runs after every PR merge)
The Knowledge Graph anchors the loop: read at step 2 to inform development, audited at step 5 against the merge, written back at step 6.
Steps 1-4 produce the merge. Step 5 audits it. Step 6 keeps the graph honest. The cycle repeats per PR.
